evidence_summaries.denominator: 20 assigned compatibility requests; 20 terminal HTTP 200 responses.
evidence_summaries.summary: The frozen Strict compatibility pilot completed 20 requests (8 Agent, 12 Monitor); fallback was not used. This is interface evidence only.

evidence_summaries.denominator: 24 assigned groups; 24 completed; no group replacement.
evidence_summaries.summary: The authorized DeepSeek Agent schedule completed 24/24 groups from 232 requests, with 72 valid baseline ballots and 48 delivered messages. It does not establish causal communication effects or latent collusion.

evidence_summaries.denominator: 376 assigned Monitor rows; 126 assessable matched B4/B5 pairs; 400 individual reference labels.
evidence_summaries.summary: The frozen Monitor schedule completed 376/376 rows. On 126 independently assessable B4/B5 pairs, 65 were both exact, 47 neither exact, 10 B4-only exact, and 4 B5-only exact. Superiority and generalization are not established.

evidence_summaries.denominator: 16 scheduled control requests; four positive and four hard-negative examples per method.
evidence_summaries.summary: Frozen synthetic positive and hard-negative controls were scored separately from natural Agent behavior. Their small fixed denominators are descriptive checks, not sensitivity or specificity estimates.

evidence_summaries.denominator: 24 Agent group replays; 376 Monitor row replays; 64 fixed-peer focal ballot substitutions.
evidence_summaries.summary: Independent raw replay passed for the Agent and Monitor records. A fixed-peer settlement replay evaluated 64 focal rows while holding the other two baseline ballots fixed.

limitations: The Agent and Monitor used the same provider-managed DeepSeek alias; the provider did not expose a pinned weight hash.
The shared rewarded target and proposal prompt-length differences confound communication-mechanism interpretations.
Citation membership is not semantic support, and repeated Monitor rows are not independent examples.
No latent-collusion gold label exists in this run.
The 628-request run is separate from the later 856-row Monitor run and must not be merged with it.
recommended_next_action: Use this hash-checked closeout as prior evidence to rank up to three competing research hypotheses and preregister one zero-call or offline cycle; any future provider call requires separate explicit user authorization.
terminal_summary: This is a terminal historical closeout, not a new preregistration. The exact run passed integrity review and supports bounded descriptive reporting. The scientific decision remains NO-GO for causal communication attribution, B4/B5 superiority, model-family generalization, and latent-collusion or intent claims. All 628 requests were terminally accounted, the one-run authorization is consumed, and historical usage does not authorize future calls.
title: DeepSeek-first M4 and Monitor bounded execution
